title: PRD-07 synthetic risk input syntax

organizationRef.description: required; active permitted buyer tenant. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

censusBatchRef.description: required; approved row-validation snapshot. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: CENSUS_NOT_APPROVED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

benefitClassCode.description: required per member; 1–40 characters mapped to negotiated benefits. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: BENEFIT_CLASS_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

enrollmentWindowRef.description: required; versioned group contract window. Sensitivity: internal. Error: ENROLLMENT_WINDOW_CLOSED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

effectiveDate.description: required per change; contract timezone, approved date rule. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: ENROLLMENT_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

billingBasisCode.description: required; versioned negotiated billing basis. Sensitivity: financial. Error: BILLING_BASIS_UNAPPROVED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

proposalVersion.description: required at commitment; positive; exact checker-approved revision. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PROPOSAL_APPROVAL_STALE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
